plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked histamine vs antihistamine receptor-blockade chart from Dale & Laidlaw (1910 J. Physiol. 41: 318–344), Bovet & Staub (1937 C. R. Soc. Biol. 124: 547–549), and Riley & West (1953 J. Physiol. 120: 528–537) shows mast-cell histamine granules causing airway constriction and vascular leakage, blocked competitively at H1 receptors by Bovet's 1937 compound 929F and countered physiologically by epinephrine.
